hook.name: HushHook
hook.description: HushHook implements a bonding-curve token launch with an optional CoinJoin privacy mode. Buys execute instantly via the bonding curve, or queue in fixed-denomination tiers (0.01/0.1/1/10 ETH) batching when 3 participants match; sells are always instant via the inverse curve. The hook fully handles swap settlement via BeforeSwapDelta, bypassing the pool's AMM math.
